title: Anakin Skywalker
franchise: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith
description: Anakin Skywalker, a young slave boy on Tatooine, was strong in the Force and always wanted to be a Jedi. After winning his freedom, he became the apprentice of Obi-Wan Kenobi. He fought as a General in the Clone Wars, all the while maintaining a secret marriage to Senator Padmé Amidala. It was visions of her death and the whisperings of a Sith Lord that drove him to the dark side...
